narrative: CISA adding CVE-2026-42271 in LiteLLM's MCP endpoints to its KEV catalog with a federal remediation deadline puts the AI-inference-broker tier squarely inside federal cyber governance, the substrate this sub-catalog anticipates. It moves toward the expected outcome, but remains a single per-CVE listing rather than a carved-out, named AI-Infra catalog carrying a mandatory inference-server SBOM requirement.
remaining_gap: No named AI-Infra sub-catalog and no mandatory SBOM tagging on inference servers yet; only an individual KEV entry exists.
